verdict.rationale: Unity's docs describe its own 3D rendering capability: they cite 'the latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects' and position the engine for 3D and high-end games. However, no evidence names the specific elements of a modern production renderer. missing for 10: documented PBR materials, global illumination or baked lightmapping, shadow systems, post-processing stack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of render quality.

support.subject: As a game developer, the engine ships a modern production 3D renderer — PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows, post-processing

citations.quote: Elevate your scenes with scalable, captivating visuals using the latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects.
Build 2D and 3D games for any platform
Create and optimize high-end games and interactive experiences.
WebGL lets you publish real-time interactive 3D graphics into a browser.
